finding.baseline: AES-GCM/GHASH constructor scratch wiping and POLYVAL software Drop were disabled by separate missing zeroize features. No private-field retained-storage probe or cross-domain read is claimed.
finding.correction: Enable all three feature edges; keep the actual TLS-selected cipher equal to aes_gcm::Aes128Gcm; require AArch64 destructor presence for selected Polyval and GHash.
finding.qualification: Current AArch64 software state Drop clears named h/accumulator fields. needs_drop alone establishes destructor presence, with wiping semantics established by pinned source inspection. Optional PMULL rejects the guard. Pinned x86 dispatch still lacks Drop delegation.
finding.ownership: Existing C18 record-cipher owner; no new buffer/allocation, capability/root cleanup, guards, wait, remote teardown, registry, custody or physical/retry authority.
